findings.title: SessionStrategy::Child resolves parent but never persists it
findings.summary: resolve_session computes SessionResolution.parent_session_key for Child strategy, but Orchestrator::dispatch only reads session_key. parent_session_key is discarded. The session is created in the store without ever setting the column, even though schema/query handlers all read it.

findings.title: UnknownFlow after successful routing leaves no graceful fallback
findings.summary: Step 1 has a graceful fallback ONLY for UnknownAgent (resolves to default-agent, overrides spec.agent). UnknownFlow returns hard error. The default_routing table maps every builtin SubAgent id to a same-named flow id, but loop-auditor has no matching preset. Latent today (gateway sends agent_id='main'), but a 1-line change makes it user-visible.

findings.title: Every gateway chat dispatch hits InvalidConfig for any SubAgent agent_id
findings.summary: Six preset flows (explore, coder, researcher, default, plan, verify) declare SessionStrategy::Child with parent_session_key unset; FlowRequest::parent_session is None in gateway. Child strategy requires non-empty parent at runtime, so any routing resolution to these flows hard-fails. Latent today but a stale default_routing entry will hard-fail.

findings.title: MoA one-shot pref consumed before the failure points it documents to restore on
findings.summary: take_for_run is called early (~line 346); restore_one_shot only happens inside the try_build_for_run error arm. Between take and harness.run there are ~10 failure-capable steps. Any error consumes the one-shot without restoring it — the 'all paths leave no state' doc claim is false by inspection.

findings.title: Orchestrator::reload_flows only replaces the registry; routing/sandbox are immutable
findings.summary: Orchestrator exposes reload_flows(new_set) but no equivalent for routing_overrides, default_routing, sandbox_factory. default_routing built once at boot from agent_registry.list_ids() — new plugins/projects invisible to dispatch, fall through to UnknownAgent arm silently.

findings.title: Dead re-export: MAX_FLOW_DEPTH has zero non-test consumers
findings.summary: pub use resolver::{RoutingOverrides, MAX_FLOW_DEPTH}; the only consumers are inside src/orchestrator/tests/. Same shape for ContextBudgetRefiner and ProviderChain — re-exported at mod.rs but every consumer imports from crate::orchestrator::deps_builder::*.

findings.title: FlowStreamEvent::Complete NOT emitted on error/cancel paths
findings.summary: BroadcastCallback::on_complete_with_outcome is the ONLY emitter (single-source comment), called only on Ok arm. Error paths reach ? operator without emitting Complete. Gateway drain has a safety-net that builds from outcome.duration_ms=0; subscribers waiting on Complete frame hang on error paths.

findings.title: Orchestrator fields are all pub; no compile-time enforcement of builders
findings.summary: All 9 fields are pub, including active_sessions: Arc<Mutex<HashSet<String>>>. with_subagent_routing/with_agent_registry function as documentation only. Direct field writes possible after construction; race risk on the lock guard itself.

findings.title: SessionResolution::is_new is computed but never read in production
findings.summary: is_new computed on every resolve_session call; only test files assert on it. No production consumer. Doubly redundant with seed_history's own 'log already non-empty' probe.

findings.title: memory_injection_headroom does full session log read on hot path
findings.summary: get_events(session_id, None, None) called every run for token arithmetic. context_pressure_reminder repeats it. Harness also reads events in runner_impl.rs:1169-1170. Three full scans per turn for a long-lived session.

findings.title: load_user_flows_from_dir aborts entire load on first malformed TOML
findings.summary: Single bad file prevents ALL other user flows from loading. No per-file WARN, no continuation past recoverable errors. Symptom: 'my custom flows disappeared' with no diagnostic.

findings.title: load_prompt_extra_files reads files synchronously with no initial size cap
findings.summary: std::fs::read_to_string on every path in [prompt.extra_files] with no upper bound on read. Window-scaled per-file cap is applied AFTER full read. A multi-GB file at a configured path blocks the executor on every turn.

findings.title: Orchestrator::new takes 6 Arc params positionally; HarnessRunner has 7 separate capability getters
findings.summary: Implicit builder with positional Arc<dyn Trait> args — easy to mis-order at call site (would compile, route wrong service). HarnessRunner trait has 7 capability getters each with a default None; no compile-time enforcement of which ones production gateways must set.
